name: tandem-monorepo
description: Tandem: measured routing between on-device and cloud AI for Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @tandem/guard build && pnpm --filter @tandem/policy build && pnpm --filter @tandem/bench build && pnpm --filter @tandem/ai build && pnpm --filter @tandem/router build
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @tandem/guard test && pnpm --filter @tandem/policy test && pnpm --filter @tandem/bench test && pnpm --filter @tandem/router test

author: Tandem Team
